definition: Two fixed slots each have their own old and replacement component. A Bool pair records the generation at each slot, not merely shape or mass: original and reassembled have (old,old), intermediate (new,old), continued (new,new). These finite inventories are shared by all bearer assignments; no whole-object identity is defined by inventory.
note: Analytical Theseus reassembly profile; not attributed to Plutarch. See docs/notes/theseus-identity-boundary.md.
